{{Top|leg}}
'''Regeneration''' was the process by which a living being re-grew or replaced lost tissue. Most flesh and blood creatures could regenerate tissues from wounds or cuts but few species could replace entire limbs. The [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] and [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] were two such species.
